Native rotations exist for ARDY, CHOIS (raw/native_prediction.npz) and Kimodo; DART needs the SMPL-X export rerun on the E4 inputs; PRIMAL, CLoSD, MotionLCM and OmniControl need rotations recovered from their native outputs (user decision 2026-11-08: recover, else 'neck not measurable')

Candidates: MoBL-ARMS (Saul 2015), thoracoscapular model (Seth 2016/2019)
